newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end a tad lower on Wall St spillover.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end a tad lower on Wall St spillover.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed slightly lower on Friday as bonds came off highs and losses on Wall Street and other bourses spilled over, dealers said.
Short term, the Madrid tone remains positive, they added.
The general index fell 0.38 points, 0.10 percent, to 384.76 and the Ibex fell 5.64 points, 0.13 percent, to 4,428.08.
Selling was concentrated in electricity firms. Endesa shed 10 pesetas to 8,100 and Iberdrola fell 15 pesetas to 1,405.
But Telefonica rose 10 pesetas to 2,655, undeterred by news of the end of its Cablevision deal or a freeze in local phone tariffs until June 1998. This was anticipated, analysts said.
Gas Natural fell 410 pesetas to 23,150, extending early losses after the government said it will place its remaining 3.8 percent stake in the firm among institutions.
One trader explained today's losses as the need for consolidation after huge gains earlier in the week.
"Next week will see a lot of (nine-month) corporate results and after strong rallies it's normal that the market stabilises," he said.
Turnover totalled around 45 billion pesetas. RTR LOL
